scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/contracts && concurrently -n web,api -c green,blue "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/contracts && vitest run
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tools/tsconfig.json
